|game_text='''0 side — My Kind Of Scum'''

Deploy Desert Heart and a Jabba's Palace site. May deploy Well Guarded. Reveal one unique (•) alien with a defined species from your deck. This card is your Rep. {For} remainder of game, your Rep is a leader. Well Guarded is immune to Alter. You may not deploy 'insert' cards or operatives. While frozen Han on table, Rebels are immune to No Bargain and Bad Feeling Have I. {Flip} this card if you occupy two battleground sites (must occupy a third with a non-unique alien of your Rep's species if a non-Tatooine location is on table).

'''7 side — Fearless And Inventive'''

{While} this side up, once per turn you may cancel a Force drain or a just-drawn battle destiny by placing here from hand a copy of your Rep. Once during each of your control phases, you may retrieve a non-unique alien of your Rep's species. While Jabba and Bib on table, your battle destiny draws are each +2. Wounded Wookiee is destiny +3. Unless a non-Tatooine location is on table, your aliens are forfeit +2. For remainder of game, your Rep may deploy from here as if from hand. {Flip} this card if you do not occupy 2 battleground sites.

A full card image re-made by the Players Committee with the mark D-E1 in the lower border (15 October 2024). Its words are the Players Committee's errata, not Decipher's.

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:JPSD-D-mykindofscum-PC-Errata-2024-D-E1-card-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with the printed card [[My Kind Of Scum / Fearless And Inventive]]: The game text changes: “with a defined species” is added after “unique (•) alien”; “deck whose lore specifies its species.” becomes “deck.”. The whole card is drawn again at 745 × 1039 pixels with the corrected text and the mark “D-E1” in the lower border.

The whole printed card image and the whole 2024 D-E1 card image, both scaled to 500 pixels wide; nothing else is edited.
